yacl3.config.stfu:config.title: STFU
The maximum number of messages to keep in chat history.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.announceAdvance: If minecraft shows advancements achieved in chat.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.advancementToas: If minecraft shows advancements achieved as a toast.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.recipeToasts.de: If minecraft shows a toast when you unlock new recipes.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.combineBars.des: Combine the experience and locator bars.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.adminChat.desc: Whether you receive a message when an admin or command block runs a command.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.compactChat.des: When you receive multiple equal chat messages, compact them into one.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.disableWidgetFa: Disable the 2 seconds all buttons are invisible on the title screen after loading.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.disableFade.des: Disable the 2 second fade animation when the game or resources (re)load.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.disableSplash.d: Get rid of the splash screens background whenever possible.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.disableLoadingT: Hide the loading terrain screen to speed up world loading.
This creates a small flicker and lag spike when loading.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.disableWorldAdv: Skip the warning screen for experimental settings and some datapacks.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.fixModelGaps.de: Changes the item model generation code to prevent gaps.
Requires a reload to take effect.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.nightVisionFlic: When night vision runs out the entire world flickers for a few seconds, this allows you to disable this.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.lightFlicker.de: In vanilla block light has a very subtle flicker, disable this if you don't want that.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.lightMapUpdateT: Normally Minecraft updates the worlds light every tick.
This setting allows you to choose the amount of daytime (in ticks) has to pass before this is recalculated during sun rise/set.
Increasing this causes a small flicker in the light to sometimes happen, decreasing slightly reduces performance.
If any other factor updates the light the lightmap gets updated anyways.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.animateTextures: If you disable this blocks like the nether portal will stop animating.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.renderThreadPri: Thread priority for rendering. BIGGER IS NOT NECESSARILY BETTER!
yacl3.config.stfu:config.serverThreadPri: Thread priority for the integrated server. BIGGER IS NOT NECESSARILY BETTER!
yacl3.config.stfu:config.ioThreadPriorit: Thread priority for IO and miscellaneous async operations. BIGGER IS NOT NECESSARILY BETTER!
yacl3.config.stfu:config.lightmapUpdateD: Time in ticks until the lightmap updates during sunrise/set.
Set this to 0 if you experience issues with brightness caused by other mods not updating.
Time in ticks until the sky color updates during sunrise/set.
Enable some of mojang's debug utilities (mostly extra logs and keybinds).
THIS IS VERY UNSTABLE AND BUGS RELATED TO THIS WILL NOT BE FIXED.
